sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes TRF-011: it targets the ship, preserves the declared owner/path structure and metre decimal quantities, requires both waterline relationships and profile points, and uses one grouped aggregation to compare every UIWL point bidirectionally with the maximum intended vertical coordinate at each longitudinal position using tolerance scaled only from the expected result.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the aggregation semantics: derive the expected UIWL ordinate as MAX(?intendedVertical) for each longitudinal position, and compare the UIWL ordinate pointwise in both directions. Do not aggregate MAX(?upperVertical) in a way that allows an additional lower UIWL point at the same position to pass; either enforce one upper point per position or ensure every upper point equals the expected maximum.
